title: Roman to Integer
description:
Given a Roman numeral string `s`, convert it to an integer.

Roman numerals are represented by seven symbols: I(1), V(5), X(10), L(50), C(100), D(500), M(1000).

A smaller value before a larger value means subtraction (e.g., IV = 4, IX = 9).
hint: Iterate left to right. If the current value is less than the next, subtract it; otherwise add it.
